en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a fast‑flowing river with rapids and small waterfalls running between rocky banks and wooded islets. Industrial buildings and mills line the right bank, while a few larger houses stand further upstream on the left. The scene is bordered by a light frame, and at the bottom in green print is a caption reading "Toppö- och Gullöfallet."
